thread:
noah: Quick sync request: Field asked for a migration plan to move customers from relay-based egress to customer-managed BGP over time, without long maintenance windows. Idea: escrowed BGP handshake + staged traffic cutover. Thoughts?

alejandra: love the idea. We should call it "handshake escrow" in the PRD so field knows it's an opt-in migration with safety guarantees.

kevin: Implementation sketch: installer creates BGP config in escrow mode: we push routes to a passive endpoint and validate prefix acceptance. Only after two validation windows do we flip active.

field-rita: Customers worry about IP continuity during migration. We must preserve egress IPs (or provide stable NAT translation) while BGP converges.

noah: Right. Proposal: escrow step reserves the same egress IP via a NAT mapping proxy for 72h while BGP validation happens. If BGP accepts the prefix and healthchecks pass, we retire the NAT proxy.

kevin: CLI examples for engineers:

```
installer --mode customer-managed \
  --bgp-migrate escrow \
  --escrow-duration 72h \
  --validate-windows 2
```

alejandra: Launch criteria suggestion: 1) end-to-end migration tested on 3 customer topologies (VPC direct, NAT-heavy, ISP-bgp); 2) migration abort path that rebinds original NAT mapping in <5m; 3) observability: migration state + convergence time in Console.

infra-bot: Ticket created INFRA-7722: "BGPoE escrow migration prototype" assigned to @kevin.

kevin: Risk: some clouds (managed instance pools) will reassign IPs on host replacement, breaking reservation. We need a cloud-specific adapter or explicit caveat.

field-rita: I'll flag those customers up front. Also need comms template for pilot invites describing escalation path and expected convergence metrics.

noah: SLO for migration: 95th percentile convergence <= 180s after BGP active signal; if exceed => automated rollback.

alejandra: We should add a manual rollback button in Console for field operators to trigger immediate NAT rebind and pause migration.

kevin: Implementation estimate: escrow prototype + NAT proxy glue ~3 engineer-weeks; console + telemetry ~2 weeks. Full GA with cloud adapters & tested upgrade rollback ~2 quarters.

field-rita: Pilot plan: offer escrow migration as opt-in to 5 early customers; rollback drills scheduled during pilot.

noah: Noted. Dependencies: infra needs low-level route validation hooks; runtime needs session-affinity checks to ensure existing connections survive NAT-to-BGP cutover.

alejandra: QA matrix: idle connection persist, streaming sessions, tokenized auth sessions, node replacement during escrow.

infra-bot: Canary build available: http://ci.local/builds/1798123385 (escrow branch)

kevin: For rollout, suggest progressive customer cohort sizes: 1 -> 3 -> 10, with automated health gating at each step.

field-rita: I'll surface this to customers and gather the top 5 who want early migration.

noah: Action items: kevin -> spike + demo week after next; alejandra -> PRD addendum and console mockups; field-rita -> pilot list and comms; I'll own acceptance criteria & rollout cadence.

alejandra: I'll include a short example email for Field and a FAQ about cloud limitations.

kevin: Starting spike today; will post progress in INFRA-7722.

noah: Thanks all — tying this into the roadmap under "private deploy: migration tooling" and marking dependency on runtime session affinity work.
